rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a branch depends on a quantity that must first be calculated from other values, such as the time between two moments, before an exclusive gateway checks it against a threshold: Model the calculation as its own task placed immediately before that exclusive gateway, so the gateway tests the value this task produces. Give the gateway labeled conditions for the outcomes, and do not fold the computation into the preceding activity or into the gateway label.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a branch depends on a quantity that must first be calculated from other values, such as the time between two moments, before an exclusive gateway checks it against a threshold

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description joins two activities with 'and' (for example, one party performs both actions for the same case) and gives no stated order between them, so both must be completed before the flow continues: Model the two activities as parallel branches: place a parallel gateway split before them and a parallel gateway join after them, so the next step starts only when both branches have completed. Do not model them as a sequence with an arbitrary order, and do not model them as alternatives.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that two activities are carried out at the same time, with no stated order between them, and the flow continues only after both are done

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a group of activities may be carried out in parallel, starting from one point and leading to a later step that needs all of them finished: Open the group of parallel activities with a parallel gateway split placed after the point where they may start, give each activity its own outgoing branch from that split, and close the branches with a parallel gateway join before the later step. Do not sequence the activities one after another, and do not add decision conditions to these branches.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an activity is carried out at the same time as another activity, so both run concurrently and a later step depends on both having finished

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two activities happen at the same time or simultaneously, so neither is a precondition of the other: Model the simultaneous activities as the parallel branches of a parallel gateway that opens them, and close those branches with a matching parallel gateway before the next step. Do not chain them in sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway for them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that two activities happen at the same time or simultaneously, so neither is a precondition of the other
